4289-4770-5301-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3755-4770-5301-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-2921-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

64-1987-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5434-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4808-5006.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Black Lotus resolves.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat.

5170-5686-6094-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

730-1479-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
730-1479-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

280-5478-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5478-5702-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

862-2292-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2743-4493-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-4493-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-4493-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Irenicus's Vile Duplication spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

713-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
713-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1977-4499-6441.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1977-4499-6441.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

1445-4050-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4050-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2757-3182-5435.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You control at least one basic Forest.
1270-2757-3182-5435.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2866-2921-4715-4986.description:
Cast Prized Statue by paying {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prized Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prized Statue.
When Prized Statue leaves the battlefield, it and Scrap Trawler trigger.
Resolve the Prized Statue trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Prized Statue from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

339-1047-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Mobile Garrison is a creature.
Mobile Garrison and Jegantha do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Mobile Garrison.
339-1047-2011.description:
Declare Mobile Garrison and Najeela, if able, as attackers.
Mobile Garrison triggers, as well as Najeela if it was declared an attacker.
Resolve the Mobile Garrison trigger, untapping Jegantha.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, if applicable, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-3028-3518.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Nissa.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Nissa's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

231-2103-2478-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
231-2103-2478-4423.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Mishra's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mishra's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

950-3201-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
950-3201-3525.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
